name: Combat Assessment
text: Make a melee Strike. On a hit, you immediately attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about the target (+2 circumstance bonus on a critical hit). The target is then temporarily immune to Combat Assessment for 1 day.

name: Double Slice
requirements: You are wielding two melee weapons, one in each hand.
text: Make two Strikes against the same target, one with each required weapon, at your current multiple attack penalty. The second Strike takes a –2 penalty if its weapon doesn't have the agile trait. If both hit, combine their damage. This counts as two attacks toward your multiple attack penalty.

name: Exacting Strike
text: You make a controlled attack, accounting fully for your momentum. Make a Strike; it gains the following failure effect: this attack doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.

name: Point Blank Stance
requirements: You are wielding a ranged weapon.
text: While in this stance, you take no penalty from the volley trait, and ranged weapons without the volley trait deal +2 circumstance damage against targets within the weapon's first range increment.

name: Reactive Shield
text: Trigger: an enemy hits you with a melee Strike. You can snap your shield into place just as you would take a blow: you immediately use the Raise a Shield action, gaining your shield's bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

name: Snagging Strike
requirements: You have one hand free, and your target is within reach of that hand.
text: Make a Strike while keeping one hand free to snag your opponent. On a hit, the target is off-guard until the start of your next turn or until it's no longer within reach of your free hand, whichever comes first.

name: Sudden Charge
text: With a quick sprint, you dash up to your foe and swing: Stride twice, and if you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, make a melee Strike against that enemy. You can use Sudden Charge while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

name: Vicious Swing
text: You unleash a particularly powerful attack. Make a melee Strike; it counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty. On a hit, deal one extra die of weapon damage.
